ctaHeading: Meadow Heights' reblocking pros are ready to help.
aboutText: With over 15 years of experience, Reblocking Melbourne provides expert foundation services in Meadow Heights and surrounding areas. We offer free inspections and quotes, ensuring quality work at competitive prices. Our team specialises in restumping, reblocking, underpinning, and levelling, backed by public liability insurance. Upon completion, a surveyor issues a certificate of compliance, essential for property sales under Section 32.
servicesText: From restumping to reblocking, we handle all foundation repairs in Meadow Heights. Our services include underpinning for stability, levelling for uneven floors, and comprehensive inspections. We ensure building permits and council inspections for compliance.

services.title: Restumping
services.desc: We provide complete restumping services, replacing old stumps to stabilise your home's foundation for lasting safety.

services.title: Reblocking
services.desc: Our reblocking services in Meadow Heights ensure your home's structure is sound and secure for years to come.

services.title: Underpinning
services.desc: Specialised underpinning to strengthen and stabilise foundations, preventing future subsidence and structural damage.

services.title: Levelling
services.desc: Precision levelling to fix uneven floors and walls, restoring your property's level and appearance.

services.title: Foundation Inspections
services.desc: We offer free foundation inspections and quotes to identify issues and provide tailored solutions.

services.title: Compliance Certifications
services.desc: Upon completion, we arrange surveyor inspections and issue certificates of compliance required for Section 32.
